cabinCategories.description: Norwegian Encore interior stateroom — smart storage, NCL's Freestyle flexibility, and crisp modern design.
Large-window oceanview stateroom with views of Alaska's incomparable coastline. Freestyle dining and entertainment included.
Private balcony stateroom — Norwegian Encore's wide balconies are ideal for Alaska's panoramic scenery.
Two-bedroom Haven Family Villa — the ultimate in Norwegian luxury with dedicated butler, Haven pool, and private restaurant access.

inclusions: All meals in main dining and Garden Café buffet

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 66 (Bell Street Terminal). Norwegian Encore — NCL's newest and largest ship in the Alaska market.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital offers glacier adventures, world-class whale watching, and a lively waterfront. More time means more to explore.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: At the base of the Coast Mountains, Skagway preserves the spirit of the 1898 Gold Rush. The White Pass Railway is a UNESCO contender.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Spectacular scenic cruising day through Glacier Bay National Park. Watch for humpback whales, sea otters, and calving tidewater glaciers.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Ketchikan's vibrant Creek Street and totem pole parks are highlights. Local seafood here rivals anywhere in the world.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: End your Alaska voyage with an elegant evening call in Victoria — tea at the Empress or a horse-drawn carriage tour of the Inner Harbour.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: "Norwegian Encore blew us away — the Broadway show was outstanding and the Alaska scenery from our balcony was absolutely stunning. Glacier Bay alone is worth the trip." — Verified Guest
